Some wire rack lines seem to merge into the pastry wrappers or fade out inconsistently. The physical contact points between the paper cups and the wire rack are slightly ambiguous, suggesting minor geometric bleeding.
The pastries in the back row exhibit slight shape inconsistencies compared to the front row, with some appearing to lean or melt slightly into the background glass reflection.
